intro.headline:
Let's build this year's budget

step by step
intro.description:
Enter monthly amounts per category, income then spending,

and we'll show the annual total and surplus automatically.

quick.title: Just the essentials
quick.description: Salary, fixed spending and shared variable spending as monthly averages. About 5 min

full.title: Every item in detail
full.description: Adjust every category month by month. About 20 min

intro.flowIncomeHintQuick: Regular income as a monthly average
intro.flowIncomeHintFull: Regular income: monthly average, then a 12-month grid
intro.flowExpenseHintQuick: Fixed and shared variable spending as monthly averages
intro.flowExpenseHintFull: Fixed spending by average; variable and holidays directly in the grid
intro.flowDoneHint: Summary, then back to the main screen
intro.note1: · Every step saves right away. If you leave, you can continue from the card on Home.
intro.note2: · Not sure about an item? Use "Skip this item" and fill it in later.
intro.noteQuick: · Other items stay at 0 and you can fill them in anytime under Financial goals → Budget items.
intro.noteFull: · For regular items, enter an average and then adjust specific months in the 12-month grid.

summary.surplusIntro: You start the year with an annual surplus of {amount}.

summary.footer: Finishing records a revision and returns you to the main screen.

validate.advice:
